arguments.literal: A frame name, an available tool or a listed family triggers no activation by itself. Where applicability needs residual semantic judgment, that judgment and its evidence are retained as a judgment, never represented as a computed fact.
P6, P1

The actor or the assigning authority selects one frame or one declared active frame configuration capable of the evaluation. Activation binds each reusable frame declaration to the exact subject and basis and loads the declared material relations and evidence sources, never an undifferentiated workspace dump; what the actor receives is the packet of REFERENCE_FRAME section 11.
P0, P5

The minimum activation packet contains: frame identity and revision; the evaluation and its result algebra; the exact subject and basis; the material relations and applicable invariants; semantic, evaluation, operation where material, and decision authority; admissible evidence and tools; the capability and context envelope; exclusions and prohibited assumptions; declared frame dependencies or conjunction outputs; and invalidation, stop and reconfiguration conditions.
P0

The admitted contract names one durable result and evidence surface; every result, withheld closure and residual obligation is recorded there before return; a conversation return alone is not durable evidence; if no such surface is authorised and available, admission refuses.
P4b

The admitted result identifies the admission mechanism and its authority, the exact contract identity or digest, the decision and the evidence, including any human override; absent those coordinates the contract stays drafted or rejected. Admission validates the contract against its cited outcome, prerequisite or experiment basis; it does not admit that basis, and drafting, admitting or retaining a contract creates or renews no authority its owner has not admitted.
P6, P2
The governed question is capability fit or a cost claim.
The activation declares its allowance and how spend will be measured.

The owning evaluation and scope declarations determine which frame obligations apply to the exact subject. Their declared predicates are evaluated from sufficient basis-bound facts: a true predicate requires the applicable evaluation and its result; a false predicate excludes only that obligation, under its cited authority; a missing or ambiguous premise leaves applicability unresolved, not false.
P6, P1

A closed result identifies the frame and its activation, the subject, the basis, the evaluation, the actor, the evidence, the verdict, the residual uncertainty and the invalidation conditions; the minimal shape is REFERENCE_FRAME section 13.
P4b, P0
Compute the material closure of the seed set under the relation family on the exact basis; if the closure is not finite and unique, the step returns a gap or refusal and does not guess.

A composite over several results declares its conjunction; the member it reports is chosen by that declared rule; every known failure and uncovered obligation survives the join and is carried with the composite; no universal order among the non-satisfied members exists.

Whether a compression preserved what the evaluation needs is a claim with the standing of any other; the compressing step records the compression and its preservation argument; the claim is assessed independently only where the promotion it serves needs independent assessment.
candidate_ready -> satisfied; refused -> falsified; incomplete -> indeterminate; re_entry_requested -> out_of_frame or invalid_basis.

For the context dimension the fit test is a measurement: the bytes of the selected context are measured before any read and compared with the declared cap; the measurement, the cap and the outcome are step-produced facts recorded before the read.

Diagnosis asks, in this order: 1 Was the correct declared frame activated? 2 Were the subject and basis exact? 3 Was the actor inside the capability envelope? 4 Was admissible evidence available? 5 Is a material variable or invariant missing from the frame? 6 Is a required conjunction or translation missing? 7 Is the evaluation family itself wrong or incomplete? 8 Is another frame required? The order prevents every difficult evaluation from creating another frame.
P2
One capable context has sufficient authority and intake.
It enters directly as constructor; coordination is selected only when material contexts, authority or required independence need it.

The drafting actor never infers admission from its own draft, from the presence of a carrier (ticket, sprint entry, work contract), from lane placement or from an active label. Prose asserting admission is not admission evidence; the actor cannot self-certify its own execution basis.
P6
Execution begins only after deterministic admission or an explicit human override of the exact contract. Absent or rejected admission returns the missing work authority without execution.
P6
A composite with a known failure or an uncovered required obligation cannot project success; a known failure A and an uncovered obligation B survive every join.

Within its grant a step selects refinement, sequencing and compression itself; selecting another actor or enlarging the envelope re-enters the owner of the grant or envelope, who may delegate that choice in the grant.
The selected context fits the envelope.
Activate.

If it does not fit, one or more of these, in combination: refine the outer contract into steps whose contexts fit; sequence activations; apply a lawful compression; select another actor whose envelope fits; or return out_of_frame.
The grant names the operations permitted, the territory that may change, and the decisions reserved to others.
An indeterminate result names the evidence that would decide, as its residual uncertainty.
P5; rc.2 RF #return-a-closed-result
Declared inputs are acquired by their exact identity; a declared input absent from the actor's materialised view is neither licence to read elsewhere nor evidence that it is absent.
A step is activated from an intake sufficient to reconstruct its governing relations without conversation history, commentary or a prior actor's memory.

The intake names: the governed outcome or decision it serves; the exact workspace subject and basis, and the inputs it may acquire, each by identity and hash or by an input commit; the evaluation or evaluation family and its result algebra; the affected relation set and the invariants that govern it; the applicable frame-set, semantic, evaluation, operation where material, and decision authority, and the grant (operations permitted, territory that may change, decisions reserved to others); the available actor capability envelopes; the conditions that make the result stale or out of scope and those that require re-entry at an owning relation; and, where the governed question is capability fit or a cost claim, the allowance and how spend will be measured.
The actor's internal path within a step is not part of the output and is not governed.
A compression is lawful only when it preserves the material distinctions and failure detections the evaluation needs.

The boundary between out_of_frame and indeterminate is drawn on what the activated frame declares and on what the step did with it. out_of_frame when the claim requires a material relation or an evaluator capability that the activated frame does not declare; whether the step exercised anything is irrelevant to this member, the ground is the missing declaration. indeterminate when every relation and capability the claim requires is declared and was exercised in the step, and the admissible evidence still cannot decide. These two cases restate RF-012's members with the boundary made explicit; a declared capability the step did not exercise is a third case and a member of neither.
P5; rc.2 RF #rf-012-closed-results
When no available frame and actor pairing can lawfully perform the evaluation, activation returns a refusal or out_of_frame; work does not proceed through implied context.
P0, P5
The method does not require proving that no undiscovered material relation exists.
A missing, failed or out-of-scope result returns its own member, never satisfied.
An out_of_frame result names the missing relation or capability, its owner where the subject gives one, and the reconfiguration pressure it creates under ACTIVATION section 4.
P5; rc.2 RF #reconfigure-when-necessary
A finite actor realises a selected outer contract through steps; each step's selected context fits the actor's envelope; the actor's internal path within a step is its own.
Standing: recovered as a composite; the generic statement is reframed from the graph profile's graph functions.

A step can meet a condition outside its context and cannot report success on one; its result algebra carries indeterminate, out_of_frame and invalid_basis as first-class outcomes and its control model names the next move.
Standing: derived.
Definitions, assumptions, observations, candidate judgments and accepted claims have distinct standing; evidence supports a claim on a basis; authority permits or disposes within scope.
Standing: independent. A bounded actor satisfying all else can still take a green label as acceptance.
The actor of one step need not be the actor of the next; a later actor may re-acquire declared sources but not a prior actor's private memory.
A step's output is a candidate until evaluated.
The world is open: a step may meet conditions outside its selected context.
P0 presupposes a selected outcome (P2).
A projection cannot trim a required member to fit a carrier or budget.

Project the closure to the selected context, recording its boundary: the excluded, external, unresolved, translated and invalidation-sensitive seams; material not in the closure stays out; adjacent material does not enter because it exists.

An out_of_frame, invalid_basis, repeated indeterminate or incompatible result causes one of: supply the missing admissible evidence; select another actor inside the frame's capability envelope; activate another existing frame; refine or extend a frame declaration; revise the frame set (REFERENCE_FRAME section 10); change the evaluation; or re-enter the governing product or method relation. The disposition follows the cause; a difficult evaluation alone does not prove that another frame is required.
P5, P2
The reference's owner, exact selector, authenticity, availability and completeness support the same consuming decision as the body.
Only then does a reference conserve the relation; an inaccessible or insufficient reference is a residual, not success.
A declared refinement answers a different question, keeps its own vocabulary and declares a total mapping to the core; no refinement adds a core member.
One core algebra of exactly these five members serves every evaluation and every step's stop state.

An activated frame contains a finite attention surface that fits the selected actor's declared capability envelope. A frame that needs undeclared ambient memory, conversation history or an effectively global workspace context is not reconstructable for that actor. ACTIVATION section 2 measures the fit where the contract selects measurement.
P0

Every known relation whose lawful change can alter the evaluation result, the validity of the basis, the sufficiency of evidence, operation authority or decision authority appears in the frame or enters through a declared authoritative input. Omitting a material relation makes the frame insufficient. The law does not require proving that no undiscovered material relation exists.
P2; P0 with the open-world premise

Every evaluation returns a member of its declared result algebra. The core algebra is defined once, in ACTIVATION section 3 (satisfied, falsified, indeterminate, out_of_frame, invalid_basis) with the no-coercion rule; this member does not define it a second time. An externally owned compatible extension may refine that algebra while preserving explicit indeterminate, out-of-frame and invalid-basis pressure; it may neither add a core member nor coerce one to success.
P5

A fresh competent actor inside the declared capability envelope can reconstruct the activated evaluation from the frame declaration, the exact subject, the basis and the admissible inputs, without undocumented conversational or historical context.
P0 with the actor-change premise

Frame adequacy includes actor usability. When the material manifold exceeds an actor's capability envelope, human authority may select another actor, refine the frame, sequence activations or provide a lawful compression (RF-017); the selection is human authority's, exercised directly or in advance through the grant, and ACTIVATION section 2 says which of these a step selects itself and which re-enter the grant's owner. The actor may not silently omit material relations to fit its context.
P0, P5
Silent omission of required material to fit the envelope is never a lawful option.

A step is the activation of one reference frame, or one declared active frame configuration, on an exact subject. Its context is the projection of that activated frame to the actor; the corpus or the workspace is never the context. Intake, admission, applicability and activation are distinct relations inside the step even when one invocation performs all of them.
A step's output is a candidate plus its step-produced facts (judgments with evidence, residuals, observations, authority decisions, provenance) and one stop state from the result algebra.

A step-produced fact is a judgment, residual, observation or authority decision produced by a step that cannot be re-acquired from declared sources; an observation reproducible from declared sources is re-acquirable, is not a step-produced fact, and is governed by sufficiency, not conservation.
For required obligations R and admitted coverage C, uncovered coverage is R minus C; combining results takes the union of known failures and recomputes uncovered coverage.

A term the claim depends on and the frame leaves undefined is an undeclared material relation: its meaning can alter the result and it enters through no declared input. A claim that depends on such a term is out_of_frame on the ground of the missing declaration.

A declared capability that the step did not exercise yields no Reference Frame Method result for the evaluation at all: the claim is unresolved, not out of frame and not indeterminate, as a missing premise leaves a question unresolved rather than false. The step's stop state is incomplete under the construction availability refinement, its work state carries the unexercised capability as a residual, and the actor says so rather than selecting a core member; an actor cannot report an evaluation it did not perform. The evaluation's result and the step's stop state answer different questions, so the mapping of incomplete to the core does not make the evaluation indeterminate. This third case is a tightening RF-012 does not name.
P5, P6; rc.2 RF #applicability-and-required-results

frame_indexes.scope: Activate one bounded step under a declared envelope: intake, context construction, fit test, acquisition and the stop state it returns. Selected for the T-01 context-cap case.
